contract: Complete ordinary struct snapshots retain optional field presence, including unset versus zero or an empty list. Omitted optional fields construct unset; replacing an atomic snapshot does not retain old field contents. Owning captures recursively isolate present payloads. Dense silence is distinct from a present struct whose optional fields are unset.
expected_retention: Earlier captures remain unchanged after source list mutation.
scope: Finite atomic structs only; not structural field clearing, general nullable types, recursion or abstract families.
